During the event, I made a small mistake, but I noticed that nobody seemed to mind. In fact, the music added to the (19) ________ atmosphere of the gathering. FRIEND

This experience changed my perspective. I realised that music could be a shared joy rather than a personal (20) ________. PERFECT

Afterwards, I continued to practice, but with a new goal in mind. Instead of aiming for (21) ________ skill, I focused on how my playing could contribute to group events. IMPRESS

The guitar, once an awkward (22) ________ in my hands, became more familiar and comfortable. OBJECT

This has given me a sense of (24) ________ and a practical reason to continue. ACHIEVE
